last_interviewer: Hi, thanks for making the time today. This session is about an hour of system design.

live.text: Implement an LRU cache with O(1) get and put.
live.focus: hash map, doubly linked list, eviction order
approach: Keep a hash map from key to node, and the nodes in a doubly linked list.
Move a node to the front on every get and put.
On overflow, drop the node at the back and its key.

deeper.label: Insight
deeper.text: The list holds the order and the map finds a node in O(1); two sentinel nodes mean no insert or unlink ever checks for an empty list.
